caseCatalog.Location: Pacific Ocean, ~100 mi off San Diego, CA, USA
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Pentagon-authenticated file. Corroborated by radar (USS Princeton), multiple pilots (Fravor, Dietrich), ship personnel. SCU published ~270-page independent study (2019). Skeptics propose IR/distance artifacts but radar+visual+IR record stands.

caseCatalog.Location: Atlantic Ocean, off the US East Coast (Florida/Jacksonville area)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Pentagon-authenticated. Embedded metadata, comm chatter ("whole fleet of them"). Mick West argues the rotation is an IR gimbal/glare artifact - contested. Strong provenance, debated interpretation.

caseCatalog.Location: Atlantic Ocean, off the US East Coast (Florida/Jacksonville area)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: US Navy ATFLIR pod; DoD FOIA release
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Pentagon-authenticated file. Parallax analysis suggests object may be slow-moving, appearing fast due to camera geometry. Most-explained of the three. Record solid; "anomaly" weakest.

caseCatalog.Location: McMinnville, Oregon, USA (Trent farm, Yamhill County)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Paul & Evelyn Trent; published in Life
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Negatives analyzed by Condon Committee (Hartmann), Dr. Bruce Maccabee (Navy optical physicist), French analysts. Hartmann: consistent with genuine distant object. Hoax theories (suspended model) proposed but unproven. Among most-studied photos ever.

caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Carl Hart Jr. (photos); TX Tech professors (witnesses)
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: V-formation photographed by college student; witnessed by multiple Texas Tech professors. Project Blue Book never conclusively debunked photos. "Plover reflection" theory widely disputed.

caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Almiro Barauna; Brazilian Navy ship Almirante Saldanha
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Four photos aboard a Brazilian Navy vessel with witnesses present. Navy vouched for authenticity. Skeptics allege darkroom fakery by photographer (known trick photographer) - genuinely contested.

caseCatalog.Location: Chesapeake Bay area, near Norfolk, Virginia, USA
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Two Pan Am pilots over Chesapeake Bay
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: No imagery but exceptionally credible: two commercial pilots independently described 8 glowing discs maneuvering. Benchmark witness case. Included as high-credibility no-image reference.

caseCatalog.Location: Phoenix / Prescott area, Arizona, USA (also Sonora, Mexico)
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Massive multi-witness event. Two phenomena: a V-formation (some footage) and later flares (USAF A-10 drop, largely accepted). Flare portion explained; earlier silent craft formation remains debated.

caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Belgian public; Belgian Air Force F-16 radar
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Wave of triangle sightings with Belgian AF radar locks and F-16 scrambles - strong official corroboration of SOMETHING. BUT famous Petit-Rechain triangle photo confessed as styrofoam hoax in 2011. Event strong, photo debunked.

caseCatalog.Location: Off Aguadilla / Rafael Hernandez Airport, Puerto Rico
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: US Customs & Border Protection thermal camera
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Thermal footage from CBP aircraft of object over land/water, appearing to split. SCU published analysis. Skeptics (Mick West) argue wedding/Chinese lantern - contested. Good provenance, debated.

caseCatalog.Location: Pacific Ocean, off San Diego, CA, USA
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: US Navy; leaked then confirmed by Pentagon/UAPTF
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Night-vision footage of spherical object descending toward ocean off San Diego. Pentagon (UAPTF) confirmed genuine Navy imagery. Sphere among recurring "morphologies" AARO tracks.

caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Two witnesses; surfaced via UK MoD / 2022 release
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Long-suppressed high-clarity photo of a diamond craft near a Harrier. One of 6 prints; resurfaced 2022 via researcher David Clarke + UK MoD files. Witnesses anonymous but image quality and MoD interest notable.

caseCatalog.Location: Off the coast near Santiago, Chile (Chilean coast)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Chilean Navy helicopter FLIR; released by CEFAA
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Nine minutes of FLIR from a Chilean Navy chopper, officially investigated and released by Chile's CEFAA. Object expelled a plume. Skeptics suggest distant aircraft (IB6830) contrail - contested. Strong official provenance.

caseCatalog.Location: Unknown / unverified (claimed USSR; no real location)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Anonymous YouTube "ivan0135"; no source ever given
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: Anonymous upload, uploader vanished. Film-grain/scratch overlay = modern stock effect; text font modern; opening KGB still lifted from 1998 doc "Secret KGB UFO Files." Zero provenance. Likely film/student project. Benchmark for LOW verifiability.

caseCatalog.Location: Nazca / Palpa desert region, Peru (presented in Mexico City)
caseCatalog.Source / Origin: Jaime Maussan team; specimens from Peru
caseCatalog.Notes / Verification Status: CT/X-ray scans exist & are decent quality, but READINGS cut AGAINST authenticity: 2021 paper found head is deteriorated llama braincase; Estrada (2024) called them animal-bone+glue dolls; independent X-ray experts say bones arranged non-biologically. Montserrat specimen (presented Apr 2024) claimed to hold a fetus (43mm femur, <30wks) - interpretation not independent confirmation; Peruvian Ministry of Culture tried to SEIZE it at the press conference, pointing to looted human remains. "Unknown DNA" unpublished/unreplicated. Maussan has prior debunked "alien body" presentations (2015 Roswell slides). Contested, leans hoax.

Scan quality is genuinely decent: X-ray/tomography show 3 layers, internal microspheres, no welds/joints, microscopy to 2000x. BUT scans only confirm a manufactured object exists (undisputed) - cannot distinguish exotic from fabricated art. Seamless spheres are makeable (spin-form/electroform). Broken custody: multiple private hands (local -> treasure hunter -> Maussan) before controlled analysis; no peer review. Scientists (Mossbridge) urged validation via Galileo Project. Unverified.

Experiencer case, not imagery-verification. Claims orbs, healing, recurring entity. Has believers in defense/intel circles (sociologically notable). Imagery is uncontrolled light photos; no independent sensor data. Testimonial bucket; included for completeness.

testimony.What They Testified: Described the 2004 Nimitz "Tic Tac" encounter off California: a ~40ft object with no wings/exhaust that maneuvered instantly and outran his F/A-18. Said "the technology we faced was far superior to anything we had."
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Strongest tier: firsthand sensory account, multi-witness, tied to Pentagon-authenticated FLIR1 video. Most-corroborated witness in the roster.

testimony.Service / Role: US Navy (Ret.) F/A-18 pilot; Exec. Dir., Americans for Safe Aerospace
testimony.What They Testified: Testified his squadron saw UAPs off the Atlantic coast near Virginia Beach almost daily over ~8 years (2014+), describing "dark gray/black cubes inside a clear sphere." Stressed reporting stigma & flight-safety risk. Also relayed a secondhand Vandenberg 2003 account.
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Strong: firsthand, repeated observations, sensor + visual. Distinguishes his own sightings from the secondhand Vandenberg report he relayed.

testimony.Service / Role: US Air Force (Ret.) Maj.; former NRO rep to UAP Task Force
testimony.What They Testified: Testified under oath that the US runs a multi-decade UAP crash-retrieval & reverse-engineering program, has recovered "non-human biologics," and that he faced "administrative terrorism" retaliation. Said his knowledge came via official duties from 40+ interviewees.
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: IMPORTANT: explicitly secondhand — he relayed what others told him, did not claim to have seen craft/bodies himself. Pentagon said it found no verifiable info to substantiate. High-profile but unverified; weight accordingly.

testimony.Service / Role: Former DoD official; ex-head of AATIP
testimony.What They Testified: Stated plainly "UAP are real" and that advanced technologies "not made by our government, or any other government, are monitoring sensitive military installations." Testified to secret crash-retrieval programs under questioning.
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Insider-program testimony, not a sensory eyewitness account. Central disclosure figure (ran AATIP). Claims about programs remain officially unconfirmed; testimonial weight, not physical evidence.

testimony.What They Testified: Testified an object "exhibiting flight and structural characteristics unlike anything in our arsenal" was observed during a 2015 East Coast naval exercise; described a Navy email about the GO FAST footage later disappearing from systems.
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: High credentials (flag officer, scientist). Account is of documented Navy material/exercise rather than his own cockpit sighting. Credible source; interpretation open.

testimony.Service / Role: Former NASA Associate Administrator; NASA UAP Study Team
testimony.What They Testified: Spoke to NASA's UAP study, the stigma problem, and the need for rigorous scientific data collection; questioned on whether govt/contractors possess non-human tech (no firsthand knowledge claimed).
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Not a witness to a sighting — a science/policy perspective. Useful for institutional context, not an evidentiary sighting account.

testimony.What They Testified: Submitted a 12-page report (sourced to a current/former official) alleging a secret program ("Immaculate Constellation") managing UAP/NHI issues outside congressional oversight.
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Journalist relaying an anonymous source — not sworn firsthand military testimony. Lowest evidentiary weight in this tab; included for completeness of the hearing record.

testimony.Service / Role: US Air Force (Ret.) Capt.; former Minuteman launch officer
testimony.What They Testified: Recounted the March 1967 Malmstrom AFB incident: a red-glowing object reported over the launch facility while ~10 Minuteman missiles went to no-go status. Has testified/affirmed this account for years (incl. 2001 Disclosure Project).
testimony.Credibility Notes / Caveats: Firsthand for the security/shutdown timeline. Note: skeptics (incl. James Carlson) argue the documented Echo Flight shutdown had an engineering cause; the UFO causal link rests on testimony. Decades-old recall.

testimony.Service / Role: Witness personally saw/experienced it — highest evidentiary weight
Saw documented material/exercise, not a personal cockpit sighting
Speaks to programs from inside knowledge, not a sighting
Relays what others reported — unverified, lower weight
Context & process, not an evidentiary sighting

publishedWorks.Title: UFOs: Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record
publishedWorks.Author: Leslie Kean
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Sourced, on-the-record testimony from credentialed officials. A go-to for cited, named-witness cases.

publishedWorks.Title: The UFO Experience: A Scientific Inquiry
publishedWorks.Author: J. Allen Hynek
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Hynek (Project Blue Book scientific consultant) introduced the Close Encounter classification. Foundational, methodical.

publishedWorks.Title: Final Report of the Scientific Study of UFOs (Condon Report)
publishedWorks.Author: Edward U. Condon / Univ. of Colorado
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Skeptical overall but contains the Hartmann analysis of McMinnville. Primary source; rigorous photogrammetry.

publishedWorks.Title: Project Blue Book (declassified files)
publishedWorks.Author: US Air Force
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: ~12,000 cases, ~700 unexplained. The core US government primary record. Available via National Archives.

publishedWorks.Title: Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies (SCU) reports
publishedWorks.Author: SCU (various)
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Independent, methods-forward analyses (Nimitz, Aguadilla). Best for technical/physics treatment.

publishedWorks.Title: The Sturrock Panel Report
publishedWorks.Author: Peter Sturrock et al.
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Stanford physicist convened scientists to review physical-evidence cases. Argues for scientific study.

publishedWorks.Title: AARO Historical Record Report Vol. 1
publishedWorks.Author: US DoD (AARO)
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: The Pentagon's own review of US gov UAP involvement since 1945. Official baseline (skeptical conclusions).

publishedWorks.Title: Imminent
publishedWorks.Author: Luis Elizondo
publishedWorks.Why It Matters / Verification Value: Former AATIP lead. Insider account; testimonial not evidentiary, but central to recent disclosure context.
